automated.pass_fail_summary:
CURRENT STATE: green. verify.py passes at 0fd156c1c with Postgres attached and VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1; inline-agent-runtime.integration.test.ts passes 8/8, re-confirmed at HEAD after the fix.

RESOLVED — a regression this task introduced and then fixed. T2 added getConfiguredProviderSessionMaxInputTokens to agent-spawn-host.ts (the accessor seam the approved plan prescribes) and the ceiling module imports it, but inline-agent-runtime.integration.test.ts mocks that module with a vi.mock FACTORY, which replaces the module wholesale. The factory did not export the new function, so the call resolved to undefined, threw a TypeError inside the awaited preflight, and the run never left status 'running'. FIX: the factory now exports it. No assertion, timeout or production guard was altered. Verified 8/8 twice after the fix and again at HEAD.

How it was attributed, for the record and no longer the current state: the stage baseline b1e1ac0b0 passed 8/8 twice while T2 failed 1/8 twice on the same test, env and machine, and reverting only group-agent-runner.ts made it pass — which located the cause in the runner. It was invisible to every earlier verify in this task because that lane skips without GANTRY_TEST_DATABASE_URL.

SEPARATELY RESOLVED, not a regression: apps/core/test/unit/jobs/async-command-sandbox-runner.test.ts 'kills a direct command process group on timeout' failed once under full-suite load and passed 6/6 across three isolated runs on the identical commit. Load-correlated, outside this task's write scope, same class as deferral D-0085, not touched here and passing in the green run above.

reviewed_scope: cache-bug-T2: the limits.provider_session_max_input_tokens setting through the parser, types, defaults, revision document, fleet import (reader version 15 -> 16) and the canonical YAML renderer, which previously dropped a scalar-only cap; the ceiling preflight in group-agent-runner.ts placed after prepareCompactionDeltaReplay and the access-fingerprint check; the POST-RUN mark raise, once per turn after invokeAgent settles rather than per streamed output; the overflow clamp normalised at the integer column's limit in the domain and consumed inside raiseProviderSessionContextHighWaterMark so no caller can bypass it; the lost-fence recovery shared between the ceiling and fingerprint paths and parameterised on restoreResumeIdentifiers, since decision 0158 makes a fingerprint-invalid session never resumable while a lost ceiling fence may resume from the re-read; session.provider.retired with a reason-discriminated payload and session.provider.cleanup_failed as a separate flat payload, published best-effort for ceiling, fingerprint and missing-session; the retired-reference sink on runAgent's options for T3 to drain; and the operator procedures whose observability SQL a Postgres test extracts from the document and executes against the live schema.
residual_risks: The cap is enforced per run and as a single global token count rather than per model call or as a fraction of each model's context window — both named non-goals of the confirmed spec, recorded as deferral D-0086.
